scope: read-only production interactions; product/customer forms validated but not submitted; CSV parsed only in browser and cancelled; no product, customer, sale, refund, RFQ, or register-close writes

checks.name: Mobile navigation drawer opens and dismisses
checks.evidence: At 390px, the navigation drawer opens and closes with Escape and the outside backdrop; ARIA state tracks visibility.

checks.name: Compact account popover opens and closes accessibly
checks.evidence: Account popover opens, exposes aria-expanded, and closes on Escape and an outside click.

checks.name: Sidebar keeps the active settings destination reachable
checks.evidence: The active Setup group expands on direct navigation and remains expanded when the route changes back to a settings child page.

checks.name: Classification creation restores mobile menu focus
checks.evidence: At 390px the Menu opens the classification dialog, the MDB selector supports ArrowDown/Escape, and closing restores focus to Menu.

checks.name: Product search filters the Odoo catalogue
checks.evidence: Odoo returned no product cards; a product fixture is required for search validation.

checks.name: Product edit dialog is prefilled from Odoo
checks.evidence: Odoo returned no product cards; a product fixture is required for edit validation.

checks.name: New product form blocks submission without a name
checks.evidence: Product name is required; dialog focus and trigger restoration passed; empty form validation was checked and no product was created.

checks.name: CSV product import previews valid rows without writing to Odoo
checks.evidence: A valid one-row CSV was parsed and previewed; Cancel closed the dialog with no Odoo product write.

checks.name: Customer creation form is required-field guarded
checks.evidence: At 390px the customer dialog fit the viewport; initial focus, trigger restoration, required Customer name and empty-form protection passed.

checks.name: Customer mobile card and edit dialog render from a read-only fixture
checks.evidence: Mobile customer card showed Odoo fixture details and tap-to-call; edit dialog fit the viewport and was closed without saving.

checks.name: Sales history searches and opens a refunded receipt
checks.evidence: Odoo returned an explicit empty sales history; a refunded-sale fixture is required for receipt validation.

checks.name: Replenishment coverage control refreshes the estimate
checks.evidence: Odoo returned an explicit empty replenishment catalogue; product demand data is required for card validation.

checks.name: Reporting period selector reloads Odoo dashboard
checks.evidence: At 390px there is no horizontal overflow (390px); the 24-hour Odoo report has no sales, so the qualified empty state renders, and the AI assistant opens/closes.

checks.name: Legacy report previews do not imply live Odoo data
checks.evidence: At 390px the sales report clearly identifies itself as a static preview, displays no placeholder totals, and has no horizontal overflow.
